body.content:
Afternoon,

I spoke with Troy who said the high low fountain should be completed this week
but would not confirm the actual completion date. He mentioned the GC isn't
paying subcontractors either and is working to resolve that.

  

He said Ron is the only one who knows when the owner furnished work and the
emergency signs will be completed but Ron has not answered my calls or text
messages today. Knowing he is busy with Woodland Park I hope he responds soon.

  

Ron, Troy, Mike

All we ask for is an update and assurance that the work will be completed as
promised this Friday.  While this may not concern you, we have significant
logistics to complete before opening.  The main issue is getting supplies into
the store from Goodwill; they are now considering whether to continue working
with us due to the extended delays.

  

Thank you,

key_updates.summary: On October14 Ron said Mike handled outstanding issues with GC subs and that a crew would attend October15. On October15 at5:49PM PDT Troy reported door openings boarded, remaining rubber mats installed and reception desk relocated. The owner's5:48PM message separately marked backlights and rubber mats done, while listing the fountain and multiple finishing items outstanding. No independent completion/inspection verification.

Scott's October14 email relayed Troy's expectation that the high-low fountain would finish that week, without a firm date, and reported subcontractor-payment issues and Goodwill logistics concerns. Ron said the subcontractor issues were handled. The October15 owner email still listed fountain, cash-wrap electrical/wire holes/shelves, cabinets, sink/mirror, outlet power, light/switch covers and storage-wall hole as pending. No later confirmation found.

On October15 owner reported seeing approved permit and asked for completion timing. Alex replied production was starting and their GC would work on the project soon. No firm installation or inspection date, independently verified permit issuance or work completion found.

After an initial $1,500 offer and the owner's $2,500 counterrequest, Thomas Sign CFO William O'Connor offered $2,000 off, reducing balance to $7,081.75, conditioned on payment received by Friday October23,2026. Owner replied Sounds good. Thanks on October15. Vendor acknowledged and sent revised invoice later that day. No payment confirmation found; attachment contents not reviewed.

October15 owner emailed Alex a draft extending base-rent abatement through February28,2027 and activation March1,2027, while continuing NNN/utilities. No landlord acceptance or signed amendment found.
No new direct City/GPN tenant-review decision, final inspection or CO found. No new direct Onesta, Quaint Oak or monitoring-provider/property-manager response located in searched period.
